Keep the open items and brain items that are still current, and find who attends.
The model lists the questions to settle, each with the memory item it cites.
Code checks every question: it has text, cites an item of this area that was open, and goes to a DevX person.
Send the brief as a private message to each DevX attendee.
Log a short summary of the brief in the run.
